title: 53--PIN,COTTER
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.DLA AVIATION.DLA AV RICHMOND.DLA AVIATION
description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5315002398019 PIN,COTTER: Line 0001 Qty 256 UI HD Deliver To: By: 0182 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The term of the contract/order will be one year or until the aggregate total of orders placed against the contract/order reach 350000.00. The estimated number of orders per year is 5. The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 25. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
